title: CRUCIX Methodology 2.0.0 corrected freeze-candidate record schema

x-semanticValidation.requiredInterface: A conforming implementation MUST apply JSON Schema draft 2020-12 first, then apply every invariant whose appliesTo list contains the record definition. A record is invalid if either phase fails; the invariant ID is the required failure reason.

invariants.requirement: Recompute normalizedContentHash from retained normalized content when available; require normalizationVersion equality and hash equality for exact-normalized-content-hash automatic assignment. Reject malformed, mismatched, missing-version, fuzzy, embedding, token-similarity, and undocumented matches.
independentOriginCount equals distinct assessed nonconflicting independence groups reachable through complete candidate-to-reporter-to-assertion-to-origin-to-group paths.
Every edge endpoint exists, candidate topology paths are complete, and syndication/quotation/derivation/repetition edges are directed, non-self-referential, and acyclic.
firstSeen <= lastMaterialChangeAt <= lastObservedAt; history effectiveAt and transitionVersion are monotonic; lifecycleStatus equals the last lifecycle transition state.
A continuing repeat may advance lastObservedAt but cannot advance lastMaterialChangeAt; every material transition has explicit provenance.

instrumentObservationDates contains exactly the six strictly increasing actual own-series dates; windowStart is the first, windowEnd and asOf are the last, and the transform uses the current and five-valid-observation-prior values.
conditioningKey equals instrumentSetVersion plus eligible count; history is strictly prior-only, capped at 252, and no cross-set/count or raw fallback is permitted.
Included readings share marketAsOf, satisfy freshness and quorum, and reproduce M, driver, second driver, threshold counts, and breadth from the included z-score inputs.
Assessed boolean inputs map exactly to signal-leading, co-movement, market-only, or calm; pending/insufficient/unknown timing has null state.
Apply crucix-canonical-json/v2.0.0, require a declared policy for every array, reject sequence-order violations, append one LF, and reproduce the expected UTF-8 bytes and SHA-256.
All IDs and hashes referenced by the bundle resolve internally or to a run-manifest artifact; run IDs and methodology versions agree across records.
